root_cause: S_2104 uses a16bit XOR/OR against scalar shared fields set by original CHAIN4 updater. On x86 scalar0xff has upper byte0. A word must match two consecutive selected byte reads for these ordinary memory reads; current implementation omits comparison/care on high byte.
evidence: Actual original updater executed; getter asserts scalarvalues.8addresses x2compare x2care x4lowpatterns x4highpatterns=512. Oracle invokes actual S_2103 byte reader twice, then S_2104 word reader. No guest reproduction claim.
disposition: Necessary but incomplete adaptation; owner decision on complete correction required. Do not call current word tests passed.
concrete_option: Retain low-half offsets and change XOR/OR operands at original2066/2068 to use low IU8 multiplied by0x0101, producing replicated16bit mask. Two additional original-relative changed lines,estimated net+4 diff lines forpair; requires owner approval. No helper or new state. Producer-wide replication is not yet qualified and could affect other modes; do not silently alter shared producer.
